notes: JHU: the official 2026-2027 catalogue lists each 'Bachelor of Music in Performance - <field>' as its own entry on the program list, and each entry's page prints its own title, first heading and Program Requirements table (Piano: major lessons, piano juries, piano recital, keyboard literature). Under the shared program-versus-option rules (#153, Deep Dive 2026-10-21 22:14Z) these are programs as printed, not options: the school lists them separately, and collapsing them would be the inference we avoid. The award (Bachelor of Music) is printed in each page's own title and heading, not carried from the general BM page. Before 2026-10-21 the shared title reader cut each name at ' - ', so all eight pages had one name and none was promoted; the narrow page-heading rule in pipeline/extractors/catalog.py program_name keeps the printed name (across 71 stored runs only these 8 pages change). The general 'Bachelor of Music in Performance' (performance-general-bachelor-music), which has its own requirements, is also promoted. The hub page that lists these programs and the Peabody-Homewood double degree (two degrees) are not.
